verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agent runtime, buzz-agent, is documented as an MCP client by design: it gets tool calls from the LLM and runs them via MCP. It ships paired with Block's buzz-dev-mcp server. The Persona Pack spec also lists MCP server config as a first-class part of a deployable agent bundle, so users can attach MCP servers to Buzz agents. Missing for 10: step-by-step docs for configuring arbitrary third-party MCP servers (e.g. transports, auth, per-agent scoping), and independent or hands-on corroboration that plugging in external MCP servers works.
